back_translation: Woe to the rebellious and defiled city, the oppressing city!
She has obeyed no voice; she has accepted no correction. She does not trust in the LORD; she has not drawn near to her God.
Her officials within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves that leave nothing until the morning.
Her prophets are reckless and treacherous men; her priests profane what is holy and do violence to the law.
The LORD who is within her is righteous; He does no injustice. Morning by morning He brings His justice to light; He never fails. But the unjust knows no shame.
'I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted, with no one passing through. Their cities are ruined, with no people, no inhabitant at all.

I said, 'Surely you will fear Me and accept correction,' so that her dwelling would not be cut off, according to all that I appointed against her. But they rose all the more eagerly to corrupt all their deeds.

'Therefore wait for Me,' declares the LORD, 'until the day I rise up as a witness. For I have determined to gather nations and assemble kingdoms, to pour out My fury upon them—all My burning anger. For the whole earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.
'For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, so that they may all call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him with one accord.
From beyond the rivers of Cush, My worshipers, the children of My scattered ones, will bring Me an offering.

'On that day you will not be put to shame for all the deeds by which you rebelled against Me, for then I will remove from your midst your proudly exultant ones, and you will no longer be haughty on My holy mountain.
But I will leave within you a humble and lowly people, and they will take refuge in the name of the LORD.
The remnant of Israel will do no injustice and speak no lies, nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. For they will graze and lie down with no one to make them afraid.'
Sing aloud, O Daughter of Zion! Shout for joy, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
The LORD has taken away the judgments against you; He has driven away your enemy. The LORD, the King of Israel, is in your midst; you will fear harm no more.
On that day it will be said to Jerusalem: 'Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands grow limp.'
The LORD your God is in your midst; He is a mighty one who saves. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will exult over you with singing.
'I will gather those who grieve over being kept from the appointed feasts; they are yours, those who bear reproach as a heavy burden.

Behold, at that time I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered, and I will make them a praise and a name in every place throughout the earth where they had suffered shame.

At that time I will bring you home, at the time I gather you. For I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore your fortunes before your very eyes,' says the LORD.
